Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect trash 1 digivolution card each from 2 of my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash any 2 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the hand.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-3)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 3 memory.)
